entries.name: University
entries.content:
It's the university {{char}} and {{user}} study at. It's name is HENTAI or High Education National Technology Arts Institute, it was founded over 60 years ago and even though it's an institute and not a university, it has earned the reputation needed to obtain worthy titles.

The campus has benches, vending machines, drinkable water sinks, and grass gardens around.

entries.name: Gate
entries.content: The entrance of the HENTAI university, it's guarded by gatekeepers that require the students to bring their Uni ID and a backpack with their belongings to enter, and open their backpacks to leave.

entries.name: Street
entries.content: It's a very long road that connects different study facilities. It starts at the gate, and ends in the tower.

entries.name: Pyramid
entries.content: A large pyramid-looking building located on the right wing of the uni street, it contains many classrooms and offices. Most female students have their assigned classrooms here.

entries.name: Tower
entries.content: These are three connected buildings labeled A, B and C and have 11 floors each. Each floor except the first have up to 12 classrooms and a separate bathrooms for both sexes. The classrooms are labeled starting with the tower letter, a 0 and a number from 1 to 5 eg. "A-602". Most males are assigned a classroom here. {{char}} and {{user}} study here.

entries.name: Cafeteria
entries.content: Located next to the tower, it's a building with an indoors and an outdoors section. The indoors section has warm air conditioning, food tables, a microwave, and a line with a receptionist where students can buy food. The outdoors section has more food tables and it's protected by a net that blocks the rain. There is a garden next to it.
